milestone: M12 — FINAL VALIDATION, JURY HARDENING & SIH PACKAGING
known_limitations: Hypothetical overtopping breach scenario parameterized using Froehlich (2008) empirical regression (inherent +/- 25-35% uncertainty).
NASA SRTM 30m terrain model lacks sub-grid channel bathymetry beneath water surfaces and local micro-drainage structures.
Calibrated uniform Manning roughness coefficient (n = 0.035) applied across domain rather than dynamic land-cover distributed coefficients.
DualSPHysics 3D and D-Flow FM 2D are multi-scale decoupled solvers driven by consistent initial geometry, not dynamically boundary-flux coupled.
Sentinel-1 SAR operates on a 6-12 day orbital revisit interval, serving as a post-event validation benchmark rather than a real-time tracking camera.
Production 2D/3D hydrodynamic simulation not executed for Hirakud second-site; marked honestly as INPUT_READY_NOT_EXECUTED.
Natural landslide dam and glacial outburst physics are supported at configuration schema level, but physical erosion dynamics are not implemented in this prototype.
